items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: Freddie Williamson gave me two weeks in Minneapolis at a bar behind the bar.

ctx.x: No, in Chicago. And John Skenk was there and said, we got togetherness, and we wanted to book me and manage me. And we set that up. And I thought, well, looks to me that there could be work here. Freddie Williamson gave me two weeks in Minneapolis at a bar behind the bar. And the boss is running around for three days, moving the microphones while I'm playing.
And finally, it dawns on me. Who am I following? He says, Red Allen. I says, you can move mikes from now til Doomsday, you're never going to get me sounding like that band.
